connector.name: Cloudscope
connector.registryDescription: Azure + GCP cost management: spending, forecasts, anomalies, budgets, idle resources, and tags.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cloudscope-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alexpota account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
env.description: Azure subscription ID to query for cost data. Optional; auto-detected from az login session if not set.

env.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
env.description: Azure tenant ID for service principal authentication. Optional; falls back to DefaultAzureCredential (e.g. az login) if unset.

env.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Service principal client ID. Optional; required only when using ClientSecretCredential.

env.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Service principal client secret. Optional; required only when using ClientSecretCredential.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: GCP project ID. Recommended to set explicitly in the MCP client env block — may not be inherited from gcloud shell configuration.

env.name: GCP_BILLING_TABLE
env.description: Fully-qualified BigQuery billing export table (project.dataset.table_name). Required for GCP cost queries.

env.name: GCP_PROJECT_ID
env.description: Override GCP project ID if the billing dataset lives in a different project than GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

env.name: GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: GCP billing account ID (format: XXXXXX-XXXXXX-XXXXXX). Optional; needed only for budget monitoring.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to GCP service account JSON key file. Optional; falls back to Application Default Credentials (gcloud auth).
